title: Vast progress slider
description: A big section title above a horizontal strip of tall photo slides (75% of the window wide on desktop, nearly full width on phones, the next one peeking in) that snap into place. Each slide carries a glassy grey caption card with a mono label and a short sentence. Underneath, a row of hairline ticks with an orange square on the current slide; on desktop a mono caption sits at the left and square arrow buttons at the right.
notes: swipe, drag the scrollbar-free strip, press the arrows or click a tick; the orange square follows the scroll position
slides are photo slots (about 1084×701 on desktop, 344×600 on phones); empty they show flat placeholders
caption cards use white text (highlight-foreground) over a dark glass gradient, so they work on any photo
